title: An Integrated DEMATEL-Based Supply Chain Risk Assessment Framework for the Iron Ore Industry: Evidence from the Gohar-Zamin Mining and Industrial Complex (Sirjan, Iran)
content: Supply chain disruptions in the mining industry arise from complex interactions among supply, operational, planning, and market-related risks. However, limited research has examined the causal relationships and propagation mechanisms of risks within iron ore supply chains. This study develops an integrated framework for identifying, prioritizing, and analyzing interdependent supply chain risks in the iron ore industry. The framework combines the Delphi technique, probability–impact assessment, DEMATEL analysis, a weighted Risk Exposure Index (REI), sensitivity analysis, and organizational risk register validation. The framework was applied to the Gohar-Zamin Mining and Industrial Complex in Iran. Nine experts participated in risk identification, and sixty-four industry professionals evaluated the identified risks. Twelve critical risks were identified across four major dimensions: supply, planning, process, and demand risks. Probability–impact analysis revealed that equipment failure (21.1), demand underestimation (20.2), and supplier dependency (19.4) were the most critical risks. DEMATEL results showed that weak forecasting methods (D−R = 2.83), supplier dependency (D−R = 2.37), and inaccurate production planning (D−R = 1.91) were the primary driving risks responsible for risk propagation throughout the supply chain. The weighted REI analysis indicated that demand risks (17.02) exhibited the highest overall exposure level, followed by supply risks (16.33) and process risks (15.87). Sensitivity analysis confirmed the robustness of the prioritization results, with no changes observed in the ranking of the three highest-priority risks under ±10% variation scenarios. The proposed framework contributes to supply chain risk management by integrating risk prioritization, causal relationship analysis, and organizational validation within a unified approach and provides practical guidance for improving resilience in mining supply chains through proactive management of root-cause risks.
